findings.actual: Only 4 to-dos displayed (Buy groceries, Write report, Call dentist, Fix bike). Task stated page 1 should have 5 to-dos but only 4 are shown.

findings.action: Compare Completed counter with ticked boxes
findings.expected: Completed counter should match number of checked boxes (2 boxes checked: Buy groceries and Fix bike)
findings.actual: Completed counter shows 0, despite 2 items being ticked (checked). The counter does not update to reflect completed items.

findings.action: Click Next to navigate to page 2
findings.actual: Error message displayed: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toISOString')'. No to-do items rendered. Completed counter still shows 0.

findings.action: Click Next to navigate to page 3
findings.actual: Same error message: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toISOString')'. No to-do items rendered. Completed counter shows 0.

findings.action: Add a to-do with no due date (entered 'Test no due date' and clicked Add)
findings.expected: New to-do item should appear in the list
findings.actual: The input field was cleared (form submitted), but the new to-do item did not appear in the list. Still shows only the original 4 items.

result.notes: QA test summary: Found 4 bugs. Bug 1 - Page 1 only shows 4 to-dos instead of 5. Bug 2 - Completed counter shows 0 despite 2 items being checked. Bug 3 - Pages 2 and 3 show JavaScript error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading isToDate)' and render no items. Bug 4 - Adding a to-do with no due date silently fails; the item is not added to the list.
